d: The biggest Bollywood box office clash of December 2026 is officially locked! Salman Khan’s high-octane Galwan war drama Maatrubhumi (co-starring Chitrangda Singh) is clashing head-on with Shraddha Kapoor and Randeep Hooda’s period biographical drama Eetha (directed by Laxman Utekar & produced by Maddock Films) on 4 December 2026! In this video by Samosa Critics, we (Chayan Rastogi, Abhishek Manchanda) break down the complete box office battle between Maatrubhumi vs Eetha—analyzing screen count, mass vs multiplex pull, Maddock Films’ winning streak after Stree 2 and Chhaava, Salman Khan’s…
